notes: Playable footprint is the bowl floor: about 48m east-west, 34m north-south. Rear mass to the north, open south, exit at the twin lanterns in the north clearing. Hills sit past the walkable edge. Props are generative ashlar or Dark Mod. Cinder Gate is the next road and is not built.
